newsitem.title: ITALY: Albanian air force helicopters desert to Italy.
newsitem.headline: Albanian air force helicopters desert to Italy.

text.p: Two Albanian air force helicopters deserted to Italy on Thursday and Italian military sources said as many as four more were on their way across the Adriatic Sea.

The two helicopters, with several people on board, landed near the southern port of Brindisi, a senior official in the city said. Earlier, the Italian navy said three Albanian patrol boats had deserted and were being escorted to Brindisi.

Brindisi Prefect Andrea Gentile said one helicopter landed at a military airport and the second at an industrial complex. The Italian news agency ANSA said a total of 16 people were on the two aircraft, including women and at least one child.
Military sources in Rome said four more helicopters had been sighted crossing the Adriatic in the direction of southern Italy's Puglia region. "We are monitoring their route," one source said.
Albania slid further towards anarchy on Thursday as arms depots in several towns including the capital Tirana were looted and people used the weapons to raid food warehouses for emergency stockpiles.
